name: @equin/plugin-packages-process-name
description: What a process is called in Activity Monitor and ps: processName(kind, id?) spells `equin · <kind> · <id>`, and linkNamedBinary hardlinks an executable under that name (same signed file, atomic swap), since macOS names a process by the file it executed and process.title changes nothing. Also owns the checkout's bun hardlink (checkoutBun), which `./equin` and the build name CLI ops and backends from.
